slides.title: HVAC office in heating season: this or that?

slides.myth: Send the new COI when a client asks for it.
slides.fact: Send it before the old one runs out. Commercial clients often want it on file first.

slides.myth: A tech's license renewal is the tech's problem.
slides.fact: Whoever books the jobs needs that date too.

slides.title: Save this before the furnace calls pile up.
slides.body: Liability, workers' comp, vehicle registrations, every tech's license. Write each date down.
